title: KTV Player 2.1.0
release_notes:
- In-player Quality switching for multi-variant HLS streams
- In-player Audio Track selection with language labels
- Android Picture-in-Picture (button + auto-enter while playing)
- Auto-resume for VOD and local videos, with periodic checkpoints
- Resume survives the Android system back gesture
- In-player toast notifications work in fullscreen on phones
- Rebuilt playback retry system — never a dead-end overlay
- Full-title display in the player (no shrinking)
- Deep links open fast and exit back to the calling app
